scope: Unpromoted construction/fitting hypotheses only. No independent-source, complete source-stage set, full canopy assembly, passive car or physical-material acceptance.
reproductionNotes: Run the fit probe first, then the release, full-model and assembly probes. These are final reproduction scripts; early raw records predate added variant metadata. Physics/runtime, catalog geometry, scored pixels, uncertainties and acceptance thresholds did not change across these probes.
sourceLimits: Visible green faces establish a minimum only; neither four walls nor a closed six-face cube is proved by the count arithmetic.
One blue upright is seen edge-on; treating it as one square remains a catalog hypothesis.
Four late red triangular pieces contradict the legacy pair of red square flaps. The first open-support full model retains those known-wrong flaps and is only a support/upright probe.
The closed variants remove square flaps and provisionally map late red triangles onto existing upper wall triangles. Hidden green floor/roof and initial side-module counts remain unresolved.
Local captions at 37.8–100 s name equilateral turns then music; they supply no hidden support or side-module counts.
No heldout view was opened or used to select these hypotheses; the production models and locked observations remain unchanged.

conclusion: Both wedges and the four-wall support construct successfully on all three seeds; transfer fails for at least one seed with both tested grips. The front-deck grip is blocked by the table and its redundant dynamic retry was stopped. The open-support full model passes release but retains contradicted flaps. Closed full models pass inventory/overlap but fail the unchanged table-penetration guard. Smaller ten-panel closed support/wedge models pass release at both zero and sixty degrees yaw; coupled 15/27-panel prefixes fail. Simple yaw alone does not reproduce the failure. Contact/load investigation and source topology resolution remain necessary before promotion.
